about: The closed-fields rule (decision 0043): the engine's field_status over NASR APT_BASE.csv's ARPT_STATUS, as every host reads its answer. O is operational and so open; CI is closed indefinitely, CP closed permanently; any other code, a blank one too, is not said to be operational, so closed (the safer side); no NASR record at all (null) is not judged, so neither hidden nor labelled. Read by engine/facade/tests/field_status.rs and the web's lib/engine/engine.test.ts.
